The '''Sanitation Access''' was a technical area of [[Junker's Junction]], within the [[Asteroid base|asteroid station]] [[Mek-Sha]]. During the [[Third Galactic War]], agents of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] killed [[Technician/Legends|Technician]] [[Frantz]], a member of [[Junker Jott's crew]], in the Sanitation Access and sabotaged the main line water pipe.<ref name="TOR:JJC" />
